$comment: Every command runs from AVIIXA_Interactive_Storyboard, not from this directory.
graphify resolves graphify-out/ relative to the working directory, and the graph
lives inside the repo while sessions run from its parent. Without the cd the
guards emit nothing at all and the Stop hook finds no graph -- both fail silently,
which is the worst way for a guard to be wrong.
PreToolUse guards are graphify's own: they push a search through the graph before
it becomes a grep over 122,241 lines. Stop keeps the graph in step with the code.
graph-update.mjs is used instead of `graphify update .` because that command
rebuilds from the CODE corpus alone and writes it as the whole graph -- run once,
it replaced 29,498 nodes with 6,849 and discarded every blueprint node.
